title: Fort Custer, Montana

terrainReference.basis: Modern unmodified 3DEP relief at the estimated historical parade ground center.

mapIdentity.provider: U.S. War Department plan measured relative to the surveyed parade ground, with approximate modern topographic registration.
mapIdentity.scope: The federal survey’s 600-foot bar, north arrow and individual footprints set the parade ground and building positions relative to each other. The USGS historical site vicinity and modern 3DEP bluff relief constrain a best-fit location.

note: E. F. Everitt’s published stereo cards establish the gabled officers’ houses with porches and chimneys, and the broad hospital with a hipped two-story center, open wraparound verandah, rooftop belvedere and lower gabled wings.
